name: Attack on Titan: The Rumbling
进击の巨人『地鸣』
author: 辣条QWQ (original by Mirka)
description: The Walls and the Survey Corps on their gear, Marley's army, air fleet and Warriors, the Middle-East Allied Forces, and the Titans: shifters who take their Titan forms, Eldians who become mindless ones, and the Rumbling.
城墙与驾驶立体机动装置的调查兵团，马莱的陆军、空军与战士，中东联合军，以及巨人：能变身的九大巨人继承者、化为无垢巨人的艾尔迪亚人，还有地鸣。

name: Paradis Headquarters
帕拉迪岛总部
desc: The island's command: trains the Garrison who build, the carriages and the horses.
基地总部，立体机动单位可以在这里补充瓦斯并缓慢回复生命值

name: ODM Training Camp
立体训练营
desc: Trains the Survey Corps, the Military Police and the Anti-Personnel troops, and the Scouts' heroes.
立体训练场，专门训练各种立体机动士兵

name: ODM Training Camp II
立体训练营 II
desc: The camp at its second level: the shifters and the thunder spears train here.
立体训练场，专门训练各种立体机动士兵

name: Military Academy
学院
desc: The study of Titans: a shifter takes its Titan form only while one stands.
武器研究所

name: Giant Tree
巨树
desc: One of the forest's giant trees: a steady income, and something for ODM gear to hook onto.
提供源源不断的资源

name: House
居民房屋
desc: A home within the Walls: a little metal, and a roof to swing from.
可以增加资金并缓慢增加人力，可以借助房屋进行立体机动

name: Large House
大型居民房屋
desc: A bigger household, and more of the town's taxes.
可以增加资金并缓慢增加人力，可以借助房屋进行立体机动

name: Bell Tower
钟塔
desc: Sees far over the rooftops and rings the alarm.
可以借助钟塔进行立体机动

name: Stable
马厩
desc: Breeds the horses the Scouts ride beyond the Walls.
Breeds the horses the Scouts ride beyond the Walls.

name: Wall Cannon
固定炮
desc: A fixed cannon of the kind the Garrison mans on the Walls: long reach, and extra harm to Titans.
大型城防武器，射程远，反巨人加农炮，木质材质容易受到损害

name: Wall Section
城墙
desc: Fifty metres of stone around the island, built of Colossal Titans. When the Founder comes near, it crumbles and they march.
城墙不可破坏，也不能自行修建，城墙上有威力大射程远的穿甲固定炮

name: Wall Section (north–south)
城墙（竖）
desc: The Wall running north to south. When the Founder comes near, it crumbles and they march.
城墙不可破坏，也不能自行修建，城墙上有威力大射程远的穿甲固定炮

name: Wall Gate
城门
desc: A gate in the Wall, and the bravest place to hold. The Founder wakes the Titans in it too.
城门可以阻挡单位进入，城门会吸引巨人的攻击

name: Marleyan Administration
马莱行政大楼
desc: Marley's seat of command: trains the engineers and the transport trucks.
马莱基地总部

name: Marleyan Army Factory
马莱陆军厂
desc: Trains Marley's infantry squads, its trucks and its armour.
马莱的陆军工厂，用于建造马莱陆军

name: Super-Heavy Factory
超重型工厂
desc: Builds the war machines too heavy for any other line.
超重型工厂，生产超重型战争机器

name: Aircraft Factory
飞机制造厂
desc: Builds the Allied fighters and heavy bombers.
飞机的制造厂，用于建造战斗机，轰炸机，可以给降落到附近的飞机补充燃料

name: Airship Factory
马莱飞艇制造厂
desc: Builds Marley's combat and strategic airships.
飞艇的制造厂，用于建造飞艇，可以给降落到附近的飞艇补充燃料

name: Marleyan Naval Yard
军舰制造厂
desc: Builds landing craft, frigates, ironclads and the Allied battleship.
海军工厂，重工业制造战舰

name: Warrior Training Ground
实验训练场
desc: Where Marley trains its Warriors: the Eldians who inherit the Nine Titans.
实验训练场，专门训练各种立体机动士兵

name: Weapons Institute
武器研究所
desc: Research: armour, aircraft, artillery and anti-air. The heavier arms need it standing.
武器研究所

name: Sniper Tower
重型狙击哨塔
desc: A heavy sniper's nest that fires at the ground and the sky.
可以借助狙击哨塔进行立体机动，可以攻击空中单位，以及地面单位

name: AA Machine Gun
防空机枪
desc: Four machine guns against aircraft and ODM flyers.
Four machine guns against aircraft and ODM flyers.

name: AA Cannon
防空炮
desc: The machine guns replaced by a flak cannon.
The machine guns replaced by a flak cannon.

name: Repair Station
维修站
desc: Mends the buildings around it.
可以维修建筑

name: Large Repair Station
大型维修站
desc: Mends more of the buildings around it, and faster.
可以维修建筑

name: Coastal Gun
岸防炮
desc: A great gun against ships, and against anything of the Colossal's size.
针对海军的火炮，大型城防武器，无法攻击小型目标

name: Middle-East Administration
中东行政大楼
desc: The Allied Forces' command: trains engineers and trucks.
中东基地总部

name: Middle-East Army Factory
中东陆军工厂
desc: Trains the Middle-East's infantry, guns and tanks.
中东陆军工厂，可建造中东单位

name: Middle-East Naval Yard
军舰制造厂
desc: Builds landing craft, frigates, ironclads and the Allied battleship.
海军工厂，重工业制造战舰

name: Military Wall
中东军事城墙(横向)
desc: Stops boulders, train guns and the Armored Titan's charge.
大型防御建筑。(可以阻挡兽巨石头，列车炮,铠巨冲撞)

name: Wall Blockhouse
中东军事城墙(雕堡)
desc: A blockhouse on the wall: troops aboard reach low flyers.
大型防御建筑。(可以阻挡兽巨石头，列车炮,铠巨冲撞)驻扎士兵上去，可以攻击到低空

name: Bunker
中东碉堡
desc: A huge pillbox that stops the Armored Titan's charge.
大型防御建筑,可以阻挡铠巨的冲撞，反立体机动，血量巨厚，可以运载士兵上去，避免受到伤害

name: Bunker II
中东碉堡
desc: More guns, thicker walls.
大型防御建筑,可以阻挡铠巨的冲撞，反立体机动，血量巨厚，可以运载士兵上去，避免受到伤害

name: Heavy Mortar Emplacement
中东固定炮
desc: An enormous mortar for the walls: heavy plate, and extra harm to buildings.
大型城防武器,可以安装在城墙上，拥有坚实装甲，能够抵挡大部分伤害

name: Garrison Soldier
驻扎兵团士兵
desc: The Garrison Regiment: builds the island's works, and is no match for a Titan.
驻扎兵的战斗力较弱，不适合与巨人作战，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Supply Carriage
马车（交易工具）
desc: Carries the wounded and the builders: six aboard.
可以运载伤员或工兵

name: Horse
马
desc: A Scout's mount: two riders, and far quicker than a soldier on foot.
马

name: Horse
马（骑乘）
desc: A Scout's mount, ridden.
马

name: Horse
马（双人骑乘）
desc: A Scout's mount, carrying two.
马

name: Field Cannon
火炮
desc: A Garrison gun: slow to move, long-ranged, and hard on Titans.
移动较为缓慢，驻扎兵团和宪兵团的单位

name: Wheeled Cannon
轮式火炮
desc: Lighter and quicker to fire than the field cannon, with less reach.
更加轻便，射速更快，但是伤害低，射程近，同时更容易被破坏

name: Survey Corps Soldier
调查兵团士兵
desc: Fights on foot with blades; with a building or a Titan close by it takes to the air on its gear and cuts at the nape.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Survey Corps Soldier (airborne)
调查兵团士兵（飞行）
desc: Fights on foot with blades; with a building or a Titan close by it takes to the air on its gear and cuts at the nape.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Military Police
宪兵团士兵（火枪）
desc: The Interior's police: muskets, and ODM gear beside them.
宪兵的战斗力一般，不适合与巨人作战，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Military Police (airborne)
宪兵团士兵（火枪）（飞行）
desc: The Interior's police: muskets, and ODM gear beside them.
宪兵的战斗力一般，不适合与巨人作战，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Anti-Personnel Trooper
新立体枪
desc: ODM gear made for fighting people: pistols, not blades.
新立体兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Anti-Personnel Trooper (airborne)
新立体枪（飞行）
desc: ODM gear made for fighting people: pistols, not blades.
新立体兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Thunder Spear Trooper
新立体
desc: Rockets fired from the gear that burst a Titan's armour open.
传说中的阿克曼一族，是精英中的精英，立体机动技术十分成熟，精通各种作战方法，天生的战斗英雄

name: Thunder Spear Trooper (airborne)
新立体（飞行）
desc: Rockets fired from the gear that burst a Titan's armour open.
传说中的阿克曼一族，是精英中的精英，立体机动技术十分成熟，精通各种作战方法，天生的战斗英雄

name: Erwin Smith
埃尔文·史密斯
desc: Commander of the Survey Corps. The Scouts who fight beside him give their hearts: they strike faster and shrug off harm.
调查兵团团长-艾尔文，多种战术，指挥若定，可率领部队持续作战

name: Erwin Smith (airborne)
埃尔文·史密斯（飞行）
desc: Commander of the Survey Corps. The Scouts who fight beside him give their hearts: they strike faster and shrug off harm.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Mikasa Ackerman
三笠·阿克曼
desc: An Ackerman, and the finest blade in the Scouts.
三笠·阿克曼，传说中的阿克曼一族，精英中的精英，拥有高于常人的回血，力量

name: Mikasa Ackerman (airborne)
三笠·阿克曼（飞行）
desc: An Ackerman, and the finest blade in the Scouts.
传说中的阿克曼一族，是精英中的精英，立体机动技术十分成熟，精通各种作战方法，天生的战斗英雄

name: Levi Ackerman
利威尔·阿克曼
desc: Humanity's strongest soldier: his spinning strike cuts through whatever is in reach.
利威尔·阿克曼，阿克曼血统，使其拥有高于常人的回血，敏捷

name: Spinning Strike
回旋斩
desc: Levi's spinning strike: two and a half times the harm, twice as fast, for five seconds.
利威尔的回旋斩：五秒内伤害提升至 2.5 倍，攻速翻倍。

name: Levi Ackerman (airborne)
利威尔·阿克曼（飞行）
desc: Humanity's strongest soldier: his spinning strike cuts through whatever is in reach.
利威尔是调查兵团的士兵长，他极其精通立体机动装置的使用，被誉为人类最强

name: Spinning Strike
回旋斩
desc: Levi's spinning strike: two and a half times the harm, twice as fast, for five seconds.
利威尔的回旋斩：五秒内伤害提升至 2.5 倍，攻速翻倍。

name: Floch Forster
弗洛克·弗斯特
desc: The Yeagerists' firebrand: the anti-personnel troopers beside him fight harder.
弗洛克，多种信念，狂热执着，可率领新兵持续作战

name: Floch Forster (airborne)
弗洛克·弗斯特（飞行）
desc: The Yeagerists' firebrand: the anti-personnel troopers beside him fight harder.
新立体兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Kenny Ackerman
肯尼·阿克曼
desc: Kenny the Ripper, captain of the Interior's anti-personnel squad.
肯尼·阿克曼，兵长的舅舅，阿克曼血脉，擅长射击，能够远程与人拉扯，拥有高于常人的回血

name: Kenny Ackerman (airborne)
肯尼·阿克曼（飞行）
desc: Kenny the Ripper, captain of the Interior's anti-personnel squad.
兵长的舅舅，阿克曼血脉，擅长射击，能够远程与人拉扯，反立体机动，霰弹枪对人类伤害高

name: Eren Yeager
艾伦·耶格尔
desc: Holder of the Attack Titan, and in the end of the Founder: the Rumbling is his to begin.
进击的巨人宿主：艾伦·耶格尔

name: Eren Yeager (airborne)
艾伦·耶格尔（飞行）
desc: Holder of the Attack Titan, and in the end of the Founder: the Rumbling is his to begin.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Armin Arlert
阿尔敏·阿诺德
desc: Inherits the Colossal Titan: his transformation is a blast that levels all around him.
超大型巨人宿主：阿明·阿诺德，阿明智商极高，擅长战术分析与布局，推理与预判能力极强，虽近战偏弱，但凭借谋略能掌控战局

name: Armin Arlert (airborne)
阿尔敏·阿诺德（飞行）
desc: Inherits the Colossal Titan: his transformation is a blast that levels all around him.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Eldian Soldier
艾尔迪亚士兵
desc: An Eldian given Titan spinal fluid: at the Beast Titan's roar, or at its own order, it becomes a mindless Titan.
艾尔迪亚人中的士兵，有艾尔迪亚的血统。（可以用于飞艇实现空降巨人）

name: Titanize
巨人化
desc: The spinal fluid takes hold: it becomes a mindless Titan, of any kind.
脊髓液发作：变为一只无垢巨人，种类不定。

name: Grisha Yeager
格里莎·耶格尔
desc: Eren's father, and the Attack Titan before him.
格里莎出身收容区，意志坚韧，兼具医者的隐忍与革命者的果敢，拥有极强的隐忍谋划与心理伪装能力\。心性狠厉且兼具决断魄力

name: Zeke Yeager
吉克·耶格尔
desc: Holder of the Beast Titan, of royal blood: his roar turns Eldians into Titans.
兽之巨人宿主：吉克·耶格尔，学识渊博，擅长研究与分析，但是情绪容易被牵引

name: Rod Reiss's Titan
罗德巨人体
desc: An abnormal of royal blood, too vast to stand: it crawls on, crushing all in its way.
拥有王血的罗德变身的超大型无垢巨人

name: Marleyan Engineer
工兵
desc: Builds everything Marley builds.
马莱的工兵，需要较高的军费，用劳动创造出这一切

name: Marleyan Transport Truck
马莱运输卡车
desc: Carries the wounded and the engineers.
可以运载伤员或工兵，需要消耗人力进行招募，需要高昂的维护费

name: Marleyan Rifleman
马莱正规军
desc: Marley's regulars: cheap, and hard fighters with a bolt-action rifle.
马莱的正规军，只需要廉价的军费，但是却有彪悍的战斗力，每人配备一把基础步枪

name: Marleyan Machine Gunner
马莱机枪手
desc: Short-ranged and all fire.
马莱的机枪手，需要较高的军费，射程较近，火力十足

name: Marleyan Grenadier
马莱投弹兵
desc: Fragmentation grenades: good against armour and against men in a bunch.
马莱的正规军，只需要廉价的军费，但是却有彪悍的战斗力，每人配备一把基础步枪

name: Marleyan Anti-Tank Rifleman
马莱反坦狙击手
desc: A long anti-tank rifle: slow to reload, and it holes armour.
马莱的反坦克步枪手，关键时发挥重要作用

name: Marleyan Flamethrower
马莱喷火兵
desc: Sets everything alight.
马莱的喷火兵，点燃一切

name: Troop Truck
马莱运兵卡车
desc: Carries a squad; its crew fights from the bed.
可以运载伤员或工兵，需要消耗人力进行招募，需要高昂的维护费

name: Armored Car
马莱装甲车
desc: Fast, armoured and over any hill: carries engineers and guns, and its machine gun keeps infantry off.
装甲厚重，能够运输工兵，火炮，速度快，突破防线，无视山地地形

name: Marleyan Tank
马莱装甲坦克
desc: An anti-Titan gun in armour: with Marley's infantry beside it, the empire's strongest pairing.
需要昂贵的军费，威力巨大，配备反巨人装甲炮，搭配上马莱士兵是最强的组合，一辆装甲坦克的强大往往代表着一个强大的帝国

name: Heavy Anti-Titan Gun
重型反巨人炮
desc: A towed gun of enormous calibre: slow, precise, and devastating to Titans.
马莱的重型反巨人炮，需要非常昂贵的造价，能够对敌方造成巨大打击，伤害范围广，威力大，精准度高，造价和维修成本高，对巨…

name: Super-Heavy Tank
马莱巨型坦克
desc: Two great guns, a ring of secondary guns and anti-air machine guns: a war machine to fear.
马莱超重型坦克，搭配两门巨炮，多门副炮，两个小型可对空机枪，可以改装喷火，恐怖的战争机器

name: Allied Fighter
世界联合战斗机
desc: Nimble, fights in flocks, and escorts the airships.
世界联合战斗机，具有极强的灵活性，也是轰炸机，适合集群攻击和辅助飞艇对空，燃料耗尽需到空军场附近降落补充

name: Allied Heavy Bomber
世界联合重型轰炸机
desc: Slow, and devastating to buildings and troops on the ground.
世界联合的重型轰炸机，行动迟缓，轰炸威力巨大，适合攻击建筑和地面部队，燃料耗尽需到空军场附近降落补充

name: Combat Airship
马莱战斗飞艇
desc: A fortress in the sky: carries a company, and fights from the air.
马莱战斗飞艇-空中的堡垒，能够运输大量士兵并治疗，进行空中作战

name: Strategic Airship
马莱大型战略飞艇
desc: Marley's great airship: it carries Titans-to-be over the enemy and lets them fall.
巨大空中堡垒！！吉克士兵长乘坐的马莱大型战略飞艇-马莱的超级武器，战略作用非常之大，曾经一举攻破了中东的要塞，能够使…

name: Landing Craft
马莱登陆艇
desc: Carries eight ashore; those aboard cannot be hit.
小型船只，速度中等。可以运输8个单位，在船上的单位不会受到攻击

name: Frigate
中东护卫舰
desc: Cheap and hard-hitting: three medium guns and four autocannons.
中东的护卫舰，造价便宜，攻击力极强，马莱海军的基础。/配备三门中型火炮/配备四门速击机炮/配备轻量装甲

name: Ironclad
中东铁甲战舰
desc: Three heavy guns, four armour-piercing autocannons and heavy plate.
中东强大重工业的代表，重工业战舰的耗费巨量资源，威力巨大！！/配备三门重型火炮/配备四门穿甲机炮/配备重型装甲

name: Allied Ironclad Battleship
世界联合铁甲战列舰
desc: The world's most advanced warship, with the largest anti-Titan guns ever built.
世界联合军舰，是当时世界上最先进的军舰，装备了世界上最大的反巨人火炮

name: Gabi Braun
贾碧·布朗
desc: A Warrior candidate and a deadly shot with an anti-armour rifle.
马莱狙神-贾碧，马莱的荣誉士兵，掌握多种战术，精准致命，可适应战场持续作战

name: Porco Galliard
波尔克·加利亚德
desc: Holder of the Jaw Titan.
颚之巨人宿主：波尔克，波尔克身手敏捷，近战凌厉，擅长快速突袭

name: Falco Grice
法尔科·格莱斯
desc: Inherits the Jaw Titan, and grows it wings.
颚之巨人宿主：法尔克，法尔克擅长治疗，正直，善良

name: Pieck Finger
皮克·芬格
desc: Holder of the Cart Titan, which carries Marley's guns on its back.
九大智慧巨人之一，车力巨人的宿主皮克·芬格尔。车力巨人以四足步行，体型精小，行动速度快为主要特征。其具有其他所有巨人…

name: Lara Tybur
菈菈·戴巴
desc: Holder of the War Hammer Titan, which forges weapons of hardened crystal.
战锤巨人宿主：菈菈·戴巴

name: Annie Leonhart
阿尼·利昂纳德
desc: A Warrior who hid among the cadets: the Female Titan.
女型巨人宿主：阿尼·利昂纳德，阿尼人类状态下格斗术顶尖，擅长关节技与一击制敌，反应速度极快

name: Annie Leonhart (airborne)
阿尼·利昂纳德（飞行）
desc: A Warrior who hid among the cadets: the Female Titan.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Reiner Braun
莱纳·布朗
desc: A Warrior: the Armored Titan.
铠之巨人宿主：莱纳·布朗，莱纳身体素质极强，力量与耐力出众，精通格斗与立体机动作战

name: Reiner Braun (airborne)
莱纳·布朗（飞行）
desc: A Warrior: the Armored Titan.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Bertholdt Hoover
贝尔托特·胡佛
desc: A Warrior: the Colossal Titan.
超大型巨人宿主：贝特霍尔德·胡佛，贝特霍尔德体能均衡，擅长隐藏自身气息，配合队友执行潜伏任务

name: Bertholdt Hoover (airborne)
贝尔托特·胡佛（飞行）
desc: A Warrior: the Colossal Titan.
调查兵作战经验丰富，擅长与巨人作战且能骑行马匹，平常状态只能在陆地移动且攻击力弱

name: Middle-East Engineer
中东工程师
desc: Builds the Middle-East's defences, and repairs fast.
中东工程师，能够用于建造各种中东防御类建筑，是帝国巩固的基础，维修物品非常快

name: Middle-East Rifleman
中东士兵
desc: The Allied Forces' infantry.
马莱的正规军，只需要廉价的军费，但是却有彪悍的战斗力，每人配备一把基础步枪

name: Middle-East Sapper
中东爆破兵
desc: Heavy explosives: devastating to buildings, but thrown from close by.
中东的爆破兵，使用的是烈性炸药，威力巨大，可用于轰炸建筑，笨重的炸药使他无法形成有效射程

name: Heavy Machine-Gun Team
中东重机枪
desc: A crew with a heavy machine gun on a tripod.
A crew with a heavy machine gun on a tripod.

name: Mortar Team
中东迫击炮
desc: A crew with a heavy mortar.
A crew with a heavy mortar.

name: Middle-East Truck
中东卡车
desc: Carries the wounded, the engineers or a gun.
可以运载伤员或火炮，需要消耗人力进行招募，需要高昂的维护费

name: Light Field Tank
中东轻型野战坦克
desc: A light tank with a light anti-Titan gun and a machine gun.
中东轻型野战坦克，车体轻盈，装配轻型反巨人炮和车载机枪

name: Middle-East Tank
中东坦克
desc: The 'meat grinder': a super-heavy tank whose howitzer flattens buildings.
在中东所向披靡，超重型的坦克，大口径榴弹炮可以对面积大的建筑进行毁灭性打击，是最坚硬的装甲堡垒，人称"钢铁绞肉机"

name: Anti-Titan Field Gun
中东反巨人野战炮
desc: Holes an armoured tank with ease; long-ranged, precise, and hard on Titans.
中东反巨人野战炮，可以轻松击穿装甲坦克的装甲，射程较长，精准度高，对巨人单位有伤害加成

name: Anti-Infantry Howitzer
中东反步兵榴弹炮
desc: Shells a wide patch of infantry: short-ranged, inaccurate, and hard on buildings.
中东反步兵榴弹炮，可以有效针对大范围步兵，射程较近，精准度较差，对建筑有伤害加成

name: Attack Titan
进击的巨人-艾伦
desc: Eren's Titan: balanced, explosive, and quick to heal. It hardens its fists at will.
进击的巨人，拥有自由意志，未来的坐标之力，可不被无垢巨人攻击

name: Harden
硬质化
desc: Hardened fists and skin: takes less than half the harm and strikes harder, for ten seconds.
硬质化的拳头与皮肤：十秒内所受伤害减半以上，攻击更猛。

name: Attack Titan (Grisha)
进击的巨人-格里莎
desc: The Attack Titan as Grisha Yeager bore it.
进击的巨人，拥有自由意志，未来的坐标之力，可不被无垢巨人攻击

name: Founding Titan
始祖巨人-艾伦
desc: The Founder. The Wall Titans come at its call, and the Walls crumble into marching Titans where it passes: the Rumbling.
艾伦的始祖巨人体，拥有始祖巨人的力量(九大巨人之力)，是不属于这个世界上的恶魔！！可发动大型地鸣，足以毁灭世界

name: Beast Titan
兽之巨人
desc: An ape of a Titan that hurls boulders like artillery. Its roar turns Eldians into Titans.
兽之巨人，外形似猿猴，擅长远程投掷

name: Colossal Titan (Armin)
超大型巨人-阿尔敏
desc: Sixty metres of Titan, born in a blast that levels all around it.
超大型巨人，体型极为庞大，变身伴随威力超大的核爆

name: Colossal Titan
超大型巨人-贝特霍尔德
desc: Sixty metres of Titan, born in a blast that levels all around it; its steam scalds whatever comes close.
超大型巨人，体型极为庞大，变身伴随爆炸，释放高温蒸汽

name: Armored Titan
铠之巨人
desc: Plated in hardened armour blades cannot cut. At the end of its strength the armour falls away and it runs.
铠之巨人，全身覆盖坚硬铠甲，防御力顶尖，可灵活作战

name: Armored Titan (unarmoured)
铠之巨人
desc: The armour has fallen away: quicker, and far easier to hurt.
铠之巨人-卸甲

name: Female Titan
女巨人
desc: Agile and clever: it hardens its nape and its fists at will.
女型巨人，机动性顶尖，具备多种特殊能力与高智慧

name: Harden Nape
保护后颈
desc: Crystal over the nape: half the harm for eight seconds.
用硬质化结晶保护后颈：八秒内所受伤害减半。

name: Jaw Titan
鄂之巨人
desc: Small, and the fastest of the Nine: its jaws crush hardened crystal.
鄂之巨人，体型小巧，爪牙坚硬无比，擅长破甲

name: Winged Jaw Titan
鸟巨
desc: Falco's Titan: it flies, and strikes flyers from the air.
鸟巨是颚之巨人变异形态

name: Cart Titan
车力巨人
desc: Four-legged and tireless, and quicker than it looks.
车力巨人，多种形态，耐力超群，可搭载装备持续作战

name: Cart Titan (artillery)
车力巨人（大炮）
desc: The Cart Titan with Marley's cannon on its back: a battery that walks.
车力巨人

name: War Hammer Titan
战锤巨人
desc: Forges weapons of hardened crystal, and strikes from afar with them.
战锤巨人，可制造晶体武器，本体外置，擅长阵地战

name: Small Titan
小型无垢巨人
desc: A mindless Titan: quick, and quick to bite.
小型无垢巨人，速度快,灵活灵敏,攻速快

name: Medium Titan
中型无垢巨人
desc: A mindless Titan.
中型无垢巨人

name: Large Titan
大型无垢巨人
desc: A mindless Titan, fifteen metres tall.
中型无垢巨人

name: Fat Titan
胖子无垢巨人
desc: A mindless Titan with a great deal to spare.
胖子无垢巨人，拥有更高的血量，回血，攻击更慢，但是范围大，伤害高，但移速慢，体积大，转向慢

name: Smiling Titan
戴娜无垢巨人
desc: Dina Fritz, with her fixed smile.
戴娜无垢巨人，拥有王室血脉，高强度恢复力，高伤害，能够忽视建筑的阻碍，直接针对人类,可以恐吓士兵

name: Long-Necked Abnormal
长脖子奇行种
desc: An abnormal: it does not do what Titans do.
长脖子奇行种，长长的脖子可以使其在咬到空中敌人

name: Leaping Abnormal
跳跃奇行种
desc: It leaps at flyers in the air, and crushes what it lands on.
跳跃奇行种,能够原地起跳,对空中单位进行扑杀,并且落地后会造成范围碾压伤害

name: Crawling Abnormal
狗爬巨人
desc: Lies in wait on all fours, then runs down what it has chosen.
狗爬巨人，蛰伏:闲置的时候，会趴在原地不动弹，结束后会获得极高加速

name: Running Abnormal
娇奔巨人
desc: Sprints with its arms flung wide.
娇奔巨人，奔跑:休息好后会向目标快速奔跑，造成践踏伤害，冲乱阵线

name: Red-Eyed Abnormal
红眼巨人
desc: Red eyes, and a hunter's temper.
红眼巨人，敏捷，速度奇快，能够抓取空中立体

name: Wall Titan
地鸣巨
desc: One of the countless Colossal Titans sealed in the Walls. Where it walks the earth shakes, and everything underfoot is crushed.
始祖巨人召唤的超大型巨人体，没有智慧，不会使用击打，能够通过用身体冲撞对其他巨人造成伤害，60米的身高，拥有毁灭一切…

name: Survey Corps Squad
调查兵团小队
desc: Six Survey Corps soldiers.
6 名调查兵团士兵。

name: Military Police Squad
宪兵团小队
desc: Six Military Police with muskets.
6 名宪兵团士兵（火枪）。

name: Anti-Personnel Squad
新立体机动小队
desc: Five troopers of the Interior's anti-personnel squad.
5 名新立体枪。

name: Thunder Spear Squad
雷枪小队
desc: Four troopers with thunder spears.
4 名新立体。

name: Eldian Squad
艾尔迪亚班
desc: Six Eldians who have drunk the spinal fluid.
6 名艾尔迪亚士兵。

name: Marleyan Rifle Squad
马莱步兵班
desc: Six Marleyan riflemen.
6 名马莱正规军。

name: Marleyan Machine-Gun Squad
马莱机枪班
desc: Six machine gunners.
6 名马莱机枪手。

name: Marleyan Grenadier Squad
马莱投弹班
desc: Six grenadiers.
6 名马莱投弹兵。

name: Marleyan Anti-Tank Squad
马莱反坦狙击班
desc: Five anti-tank riflemen.
5 名马莱反坦狙击手。

name: Marleyan Flamethrower Squad
马莱喷火班
desc: Five flamethrowers.
5 名马莱喷火兵。

name: Middle-East Rifle Squad
中东步兵班
desc: Six Middle-East riflemen.
6 名中东士兵。

name: Middle-East Sapper Squad
中东爆破班
desc: Five sappers.
5 名中东爆破兵。
